decisions.question: Should blocking QA require a because explanation for each uncertainty within a sentence?
decisions.context: convex/ai/qaChecks.ts:93-105 uses uncertaintyMarkers.some and one because check per sentence. The story requires the existing detector and excludes a new linguistic methodology detector.

options.label: Approve statement-level detection
options.intent: Define deterministic boundaries for multiple uncertainties, amend detector scope, and implement per-statement because checks with positive and negative regressions.

decisions.question: Should privacy scrubbing extend to historical section edits and Brain sources?
decisions.context: convex/learning.ts:100-116 returns stored section text, and convex/brain.ts:229-248 scrubs new nominations only. docs/product-domain.md:1661-1666 explicitly records forward-only scrubbing without historical backfill.

options.label: Approve historical remediation
options.intent: Approve historical-data scope and a bounded remediation or read-boundary strategy for old section events and Brain sources, preserving governance and testing legacy rows.

options.label: Keep forward-only scope
options.resolution: Accept historical rows remaining outside CAP-1's documented privacy boundary.

decisions.question: Should privacy scrubbing cover QA feedback, candidate comments and approved writer feedback?
decisions.context: convex/learning.ts:38-45, :58-62 and :138-150 return raw strings, and convex/brain.ts:698-705 imports unsanitized writer feedback. docs/product-domain.md:1663-1666 explicitly excludes those other learning and import streams.

options.label: Extend privacy boundaries
options.intent: Approve extending privacy to all three streams, scrub project identifiers and contacts at digest and Brain crossings, and test project-linked and orphan inputs.

options.label: Retain selected boundaries
options.resolution: Keep these streams outside CAP-1's explicitly selected privacy scope.

decisions.question: Should curated Brain import titles redact client identifiers?
decisions.context: convex/ingestion.ts:198 derives titles from clientName, fiscalYearLabel and name; labels reach prompts through convex/ai/brain/retrieve.ts:115. docs/the-brain.md:88-90 excludes curated imports from nomination-only privacy.

options.label: Scrub curated labels
options.intent: Approve curated-label de-identification, remove client identifiers before source creation, and test useful prompt-facing titles without client names.

options.label: Preserve curated labels
options.resolution: Retain identifying titles for administrator-curated sources under the documented exclusion.

decisions.question: Should proposal-edit privacy survive project renames?
decisions.context: convex/learning.ts:82-91 scrubs historical edits against the live project. docs/product-domain.md:1637-1642 accepts old-name survival, while the story excludes chat write-site and schema changes.

options.label: Approve durable scrub context
options.intent: Approve write-time scrubbing or historical identifier capture, amend scope restrictions, and test that project renames cannot re-expose old identifiers.

options.label: Accept current-name matching
options.resolution: Retain current-project matching and its explicitly documented rename limitation.
